atoms.b: Wanting to achieve something is like climbing a ((++mountain pillow)). We know where the end is, but we need to find a way to get there and overcome obstacles.
Thinking about our ((++goals fears)) can help us climb that mountain. We can make a ((++plan cake)) and break down the steps we need to take.
Goals can help us stay motivated because the big mountain turns into several ((++smaller massive)) hills instead.
Achieving goals can also positively influence the way we think about ((++ourselves pets)). While working towards a goal we can grow as a person.

instruction.text: Select the three things that people might base their goals on.

feedback.finish: People may have different ideas of what types of goals are important to them. Even if someone’s goals are different to yours, they are still just as important.

instruction.text: Look at the images and decide which goal they represent.

trainers.instruction: How does reaching a goal make you feel? Decide if these statements are true or false.

atoms.a: When I reach my goals, I am proud of myself.
When I reach my goals, I am sad because I got what I wanted.
When I reach my goals, I know that I can achieve things I set my mind to.
When I reach my goals, I am angry that I overcame obstacles.
When I reach my goals, I feel confident because I know I can overcome obstacles.

feedback.end: Reaching a goal rarely happens without setbacks, and being able to overcome these can boost your confidence and develop problem-solving skills. Achieving a goal takes a lot of work, so you can feel proud of yourself for putting in the effort and completing tasks you set for yourself.
